title: Ultrafiltration-based _in vitro_ assay for determining polyamine binding to proteins
protocol: Label the microcentrifuge tubes and keep them on ice.
Prepare the polyamine binding mix in pre-cooled microcentrifuge tubes as shown in Table A & B.
Mix the polyamine binding mix gently.
Incubate the mixed polyamine binding mix on ice for 60 min.
Place the filtration device in a 1.5 ml collection tube and pre-cool on ice.
Transfer 100 μL of the polyamine binding mix to appropriately labelled filtration devices after the 60 min incubation time.
Filter free polyamines by spinning at 2500xg for 5 min at 4°C.
Prepare microcentrifuge tubes with 1 mL scintillation liquid (two tubes per filter device).
Remove 10 μL of retentate from inside the cut-off filter device and add it to a microcentrifuge tube marked as “retentate”.
Remove 10 μL of filtrate from the collection tube of the filtration device and add it to another microcentrifuge tube marked as “filtrate”.
Calculate the percentage of protein-bound polyamines using the formula: \((CPMretentate - CPMfiltrate) / CPMretentate * 100\).
